header: WHAT THE SEARCH LINE NEEDS TO KNOW ABOUT THIS TOPIC (pure, no React): the words that ask for the provident fund page, which has two tabs: the probable PF at retirement, and the EMI of a refundable PF loan. A line about the loan (emi, loan, instalment, repayment) opens the page on the loan tab. The loan EMI calculators of banks and societies are not here: the only EMI calculator is the PF loan's. How it looks in the panel is in ui.tsx; its logic is in the files beside this one. I list it once, in src/tools/registry.ts.
